results.title: Virtual fixtures: perceptual tools for telerobotic manipulation
results.abstract: The fundamental purpose of a telepresence system is to extend an operator's sensory-n facilities and problem solving abilities to a remote environment. Telepresence is achieve projecting the operator's manipulatory dexterity to a remote site while reflecting sensory feed from that site so realistically that the operator actually feels present in the remote location order to enhance operator performance and understanding within remote environments, research and development of telepresence systems has been directed towards improving the fidelity of the link between operator and environment. Although higher fidelity interfaces important to the advancement of telepresence system, the work described in this paper actually looks at the beneficial effects of corrupting the link between operator and remote environment introducing abstract perceptual information into the interface called virtual fixtures.

results.title: Verifying safety properties of a powerPC™ Microprocessor using symbolic model checking without BDDs
results.abstract: In [1] Bounded Model Checking with the aid of satisfiability solving (SAT) was introduced as an alternative to symbolic model checking with BDDs. In this paper we show how bounded model checking can take advantage of specialized optimizations. We present a bounded version of the cone of influence reduction. We have successfully applied this idea in checking safety properties of a PowerPC microprocessor at Motorola’s Somerset PowerPC design center. Based on that experience, we propose a verification methodology that we feel can bring model checking into the mainstream of industrial chip design.

results.title: Virtual simulation model of portable inverted pendulum
results.abstract: As a typical unstable linear system, the inverted pendulum has the characteristics of simple structure and low cost, and has been widely used in robotics and aerospace. A modeling method based on the combination of the Matlab virtual simulation and test data is proposed, so as to solve the problem of deviation between theoretical modeling and engineering application of the portable linear inverted pendulum. The rigid body model of the inverted pendulum is obtained by connecting SolidWorks with Matlab, and the electromechanical part is added in the SimMechanics, so as to obtain the ideal model of the system at the unstable equilibrium point. The pendulum swinging are studied for the inverted pendulum on the basis of the model. The test results show that the virtual simulation model can visually display and record the changes of the system variables.

results.title: Viability of On-Orbit Servicing Spacecraft to Prolong the Operational Life of Satellites
results.abstract: This research paper is an extensive literature review and data analysis on the viability of on-orbit servicing (OOS) spacecraft to prolong the operational life of satellites. A systematic analysis of the Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) Satellite Database found that Sentinel 1A and 1B orbit at approximately the same height as Landsat 7 (∼700 km) and have a collective propellant mass (MProp) of 308 kg which is less than Landsat 7′s 544 kg. The On-orbit Servicing, Assembly and Manufacturing (OSAM) 1 spacecraft has the capacity to refuel both Sentinels as an alternative option to Landsat 7. For OSAM 1 to refuel Landsat 7, it is $261.91 M cheaper than replacement and the more economically viable and sustainable option. OSAM 1 will mitigate the immediate problem of space debris. However, a new model of standardized cooperative satellites with external plug-in interfaces could facilitate both planned and unplanned upgrades, modifications and repairs for changing missions and technology updates for the future.
